# Third-party attribution

Calendar widget selectors and publishing field mapping in `app/platform_bridge.py`
and `app/static/platform-dom.js` are adapted from **social-auto-upload-web-ui-pro**
(千帆云递), https://github.com/laoshalab/social-auto-upload-web-ui-pro,
commit 6b1474be2de1859122ab2f0f30e781cacec4e5e4 (MIT).
Original files: `backend/impl/douyin/platform.py`, `backend/impl/channels/platform.py`.
The license is retained alongside this notice. Implementations are modified for
explicit existing-tab routing, current WeChat Wujie Shadow DOM, native topic
selection, exact field readback, and failure reporting.

The upstream project **social-auto-upload**, https://github.com/dreammis/social-auto-upload,
commit 3847fff01f5434a8a32829833163cd6723cabc59, was evaluated as a reference.
Full source checkouts for both projects are saved in the workspace research folder.
